selected_option: Amend CISPEED-01/02 to permit a newly declared repaired-control comparison
original_CISPEED_01: Contributors receive the required PR CI result at least 20% faster by median elapsed time than the newly captured baseline, using a comparison method fixed before optimization.
amended_claim: The final candidate delivers the required PR CI result at least 20% sooner by ordinary median than a newly declared repaired control, with no increase in empirical nearest-rank p95 wait or actual runner time per comparable PR. Necessary correctness/environment repairs are common; only declared speed treatments differ. Freeze method and identities before new collection.
